craft_notes: Sthāyin: mirror-method (own-body vision against itself). Rows: row 2 (wasted→wastes away — the doubled kṣaya is the echo: subject wastes, impurity wastes). Close: away (the direction — kṣayīna). Rejected: 'dissociates' — killed: unsupported kept; 'in a moment' trimmed — killed: kṣaṇāt is the promise (instant).

lines: Seat, bed, standing, unsupported, own-body vision:
mind wasted — in a moment impurity wastes away.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āsane śayane sthitvā nirādhāraṃ vibhāvayan | svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What wastes in a moment? → Envisioning own body unsupported, impurity wastes in a moment.
